cases.explain: «бессмысленных даров» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me. New moons, Sabbaths, and convocations: I can’t stand evil assemblies.

cases.explain: «священных дубов» — after the preposition «из-за», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.
